name: Logo cloud / "trusted by" strip
description: A muted row of company wordmarks under a small label. Marquees slowly and pauses on hover.

name: Testimonial wall
description: A multi-column masonry of quote cards — quote, initials avatar, name and role. Static.

name: Quote slider
description: One large rotating testimonial. Prev / next buttons and dots advance it; it also auto-advances every 6s.

name: Newsletter / waitlist capture
description: An inline email capture that swaps to a success state on submit; also opens in a native <dialog>.

name: Video demo modal
description: A 16:9 thumbnail with a circular play button that opens a placeholder video frame in a native <dialog>.

name: Customer case-study cards
description: A three-up grid — wordmark, a headline metric, a one-line summary, an industry chip, and a read-story link.

name: Trust / guarantee bar
description: A row of four icon + label reassurances, the kind that sits just beside a final CTA. Static.
